title: Lab 4 - CI for the XYZ Node.js app
description: Unit tests, JUnit and coverage reports, an advisory lint job - visible in the merge request.
scenario: Import the nodejs-app, write its test stage, and make the merge request show failing tests and coverage without opening a log.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - Import and unit-tests
tasks.instructions: Import nodejs-app under xyz-team; add the workflow from week 3 and a unit-tests job (node:20-alpine, npm ci, npm test). Open an MR with a deliberately failing test.
tasks.solution:
unit-tests:
  stage: test
  image: node:20-alpine
  script: ["npm ci", "npm test"]
tasks.verification: MR shows 'Pipeline failed' and the Merge button is disabled when 'Pipelines must succeed' is on.

tasks.title: Task 2 - JUnit report
tasks.instructions: Add jest-junit, write reports/junit.xml, publish it with artifacts:reports:junit and when: always.
tasks.verification: The MR's Test summary names the failing test; the pipeline has a Tests tab.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Coverage
tasks.instructions: Add the coverage: regex for Jest's 'All files' line and a Cobertura coverage_report.
tasks.solution:
coverage: '/All files[^|]*\|[^|]*\s+([\d\.]+)/'
artifacts:
  reports:
    coverage_report: {coverage_format: cobertura, path: coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml}
tasks.verification: The job shows a coverage %, the MR shows the delta, changed lines are highlighted in the diff.

tasks.title: Task 4 - Advisory lint
tasks.instructions: Add a lint job with eslint-formatter-gitlab, a codequality report, and allow_failure on exit code 1 only.
tasks.verification: Lint findings appear in the MR widget; pipeline 'passed with warnings'.
